recap.text: Katia asks whether Mordecai made the stuff, and four moonshine jugs of bubbling yellow liquid sit on the counter, each labelled Uncle Morty's Insta Lawn-Kill and Undead Repellant, Extra-Strength Edition. A mile short of the creeper, in the mud and rain, Carl pours a potion into the sling cup of the venomous elven rock chucker and hits the lever. beats.headline: Four jugs on the counter
beats.text: Katia asks whether Mordecai made the stuff. Four moonshine jugs of bubbling yellow liquid sit on the counter, one almost as big as he is, labelled Uncle Morty's Insta Lawn-Kill and Undead Repellant, Extra-Strength Edition. He took a weedkiller designed to take out an odious bloom and added anti-undead boosts. Each jug has enough for two or three, maybe four. Louis's Tent the House ability spreads a potion over a wide area, but he must use it at maximum distance: the stuff is very flammable, and if it catches fire before it is absorbed, it will not work. Carl takes two jugs, Louis the other two.
beats.gist: Katia asks if Mordecai made the jugs of weedkiller, and Carl and Louis each take two.

beats.headline: Into the sling cup
beats.text: Carl's delivery system was over-engineered. The venomous elven rock chucker taken from the Dream hunters has a Poison Cloud enhancement, and a potion poured into the little cup on the side of the sling changes the poison. A mile short of the creeper, in the mud and rain, Donut climbs a tree to watch. Carl adds the poison, hits the lever, and a rock flies. You hit it perfectly, says Donut; the green stuff is getting all messed up by the rain. Mordecai said that would help. A few seconds after that, the notice comes: a creeper has fallen, credit to Crawler Princess Donut. Thirty remain.
beats.gist: Carl poisons a sling rock, and Donut, up a tree, earns the creeper kill.
